1: # Grace Church - Frontend Web Applications
2: 
3: This directory contains the user-facing web applications for Grace Church & Ministries, organized cleanly in one dedicated frontend folder.
4: 
5: ---
6: 
7: ## Directory Structure
8: 
9: ```
10: frontend/
11: ├── index.html                  # Grace Church main portal landing page
12: ├── bible/                      # Online Bible web application module
13: │   ├── index.html              # Bible reader user interface
14: │   ├── bible-app.js            # Main application coordinator & state manager
15: │   ├── bible-reader.js         # Scripture chapter rendering & typography
16: │   ├── bible-navigation.js     # Book, chapter, and testament navigation selector
17: │   ├── bible-search.js         # Scripture full-text search interface
18: │   ├── bible-daily-verse.js    # Verse of the Day devotional widget
19: │   ├── bible-bookmarks.js      # Local bookmark & favorite passages manager
20: │   ├── bible-offline.js        # Offline storage and download progress manager
21: │   ├── bible-styles.css        # Responsive styling with dark & light themes
22: │   ├── sw.js                   # Service Worker for PWA and offline caching
23: │   └── README.md               # Detailed module documentation
24: └── README.md                   # This file
25: ```
26: 
27: ---
28: 
29: ## How It Works
30: 
31: ### 1. Standalone or Unified Serving
32: - When running the FastAPI backend (`python backend/run_server.py`), FastAPI automatically serves this frontend at `http://localhost:8000/`.
33: - The Church landing page is accessible at `http://localhost:8000/`.
34: - The Online Bible application is accessible at `http://localhost:8000/bible/`.
35: 
36: ### 2. Multi-Frontend & Future Frontend Compatibility
37: In the future, if you develop a separate frontend (such as a React, Next.js, Vue, or Flutter app) running on a different port or server (e.g. `http://localhost:5173`):
38: - The backend has **CORS fully enabled** for all origins (`*`).
39: - You can configure the API endpoint URL by setting `window.API_BASE_URL`:
40:   ```html
41:   <script>
42:     window.API_BASE_URL = "http://localhost:8000";
43:   </script>
44:   ```
45: - If `window.API_BASE_URL` is omitted or empty, it automatically defaults to relative paths (`/api/bible/...`), ensuring zero-configuration operation when served by FastAPI or a reverse proxy.
46: 
47: ---
48: 
49: ## Features
50: - **Bilingual Scripture**: English King James Version (KJV) and Telugu Holy Bible (పరిశుద్ధ గ్రంథము).
51: - **Parallel Mode**: Side-by-side or stacked dual-translation reading.
52: - **Full Offline Capability**: Service Worker and Cache API enable reading without internet.
53: - **Privacy-First**: Bookmarks and preferences are stored locally in the browser (`localStorage`).
54: - **Devotional Daily Verses**: Pre-mapped 366 daily verses with automatic day-of-year calculation.

# Dedicated Online Bible React Module (`frontend/bible/`)

## Module Structure

The Bible frontend has been converted into a modular, responsive **React (JSX)** interface matching the design system:

```
frontend/bible/
├── index.html                   # React app entry point (React 18 & Babel Standalone mount to #root)
├── BibleApp.jsx                 # Main React container coordinating state & Hooks
├── bible-react.css              # Responsive styling matching the UI design system (Light & Dark theme)
├── mockData.js                  # Canonical books index, Genesis 1 bilingual verses (1-31), Daily Verse
├── assets/
│   └── hero_cross_sunset.jpg    # Sunset mountain cross background image for hero banner
├── components/
│   ├── Sidebar.jsx              # Left sidebar with logo, navigation links, and scripture citation
│   ├── TopBar.jsx               # Language selectors (KJV & Telugu), font sizing, theme, and Online badge
│   ├── DailyVerseHero.jsx       # Verse of the Day banner with sunrise backdrop & Read Chapter CTA
│   ├── ViewTabs.jsx             # Read Scripture, Search Bible, Bookmarks, and Offline Reading tabs
│   ├── PassageNavigation.jsx    # Testament filters (All, OT, NT), Book, Chapter & Verse dropdowns, Prev/Next
│   ├── ScriptureReader.jsx      # Scripture reader card with verse numbers, search, bookmark & copy actions
│   ├── SearchPanel.jsx          # Full-text Scripture search interface with keyword results
│   ├── BookmarksPanel.jsx       # Saved verses management panel with quick navigation & copy
│   └── OfflinePanel.jsx         # Offline storage status cards for KJV and Telugu Holy Bible
└── README.md                    # This module documentation
```

---

## React Component Architecture

All UI components are built as reusable **React functional components** utilizing modern React Hooks (`useState`, `useEffect`, `useMemo`, `useCallback`):

1. **`Sidebar`**: Left navigation sidebar featuring the Grace Church Bible brand header with Latin cross emblem, navigation items with badge counts, and the Psalm 119:105 Scripture citation box.
2. **`TopBar`**: Utility controls header with English (KJV) and Telugu dropdown selectors, font size adjustment buttons (`A-`, `A+`), theme switch (`☀️` / `🌙`), and live Online status pill.
3. **`DailyVerseHero`**: Devotional banner featuring the rustic wooden cross sunset hillside, date badge, italic serif quotation, bilingual references, and 1-click chapter jump button.
4. **`ViewTabs`**: Horizontal navigation tabs with active royal blue pill styling and active indicator underline.
5. **`PassageNavigation`**: Filters for `All`, `OT (పాత నిబంధన)`, and `NT (కొత్త నిబంధన)`, customized dropdown selectors for Bible books, chapters, and verses, plus `< Previous` and `Next >` navigation buttons.
6. **`ScriptureReader`**: Elevated reading card displaying the chapter title, Telugu subtitle, `KJV` and verse total badges, circular verse numbers (`1`, `2`, ...), and per-verse interactive actions (Search `🔍`, Bookmark `★`, and Copy `📋`).
7. **`SearchPanel`**: Scripture search interface with testament scope filtering and highlighted verse result cards.
8. **`BookmarksPanel`**: Saved favorite verses list with 1-click reader jump, copy, and removal.
9. **`OfflinePanel`**: Browser Cache API storage management cards for English KJV and Telugu Holy Bible.

---

## Features & Controls

- **Bilingual Support**: Instant toggle between English King James Version (KJV) and Telugu Holy Bible (పరిశుద్ధ గ్రంథము).
- **Responsive Layout**: Designed for desktop (2-column layout with fixed left sidebar), tablet, and mobile (collapsible slide-out drawer).
- **Dynamic Font Sizing**: Interactive `A-` and `A+` controls scale verse typography dynamically across the reader.
- **Dual Themes**: Supports Minimalist Warm Light mode and Sanctuary Midnight Dark mode (`data-theme="dark"`).
- **Zero-CORS Browser Compatibility**: Runs universally when served via local HTTP server (`http://localhost:8000/bible/`) or directly opened via file URL.

---

## Local Development & Testing

When running the FastAPI server from workspace root:
```bash
python backend/run_server.py
```

Access the Bible module in your browser:
- **Online Bible**: [http://localhost:8000/bible/](http://localhost:8000/bible/)

# Grace Church - Frontend Web Applications

This directory contains the user-facing web applications for Grace Church & Ministries, organized cleanly in one dedicated frontend folder.

---

## Directory Structure

```
frontend/
├── index.html                  # Grace Church main portal landing page
├── home/                       # Church home assets and resources
│   └── assets/                 # Photography and banner images
├── bible/                      # Online Bible React web application module
│   ├── index.html              # React entry point mounting to #root
│   ├── BibleApp.jsx            # Main React coordinator & state container
│   ├── bible-react.css         # Minimalist responsive design system (Light & Dark themes)
│   ├── mockData.js             # Canonical Bible books metadata, Genesis 1 verses & Daily Verse
│   ├── assets/                 # Bible module assets (hero_cross_sunset.jpg)
│   ├── components/             # Reusable React Functional Components (JSX)
│   │   ├── Sidebar.jsx         # Left navigation sidebar & scripture quote box
│   │   ├── TopBar.jsx          # Language selectors, font controls, theme toggle, Online status
│   │   ├── DailyVerseHero.jsx  # Verse of the Day banner with sunrise cross backdrop
│   │   ├── ViewTabs.jsx        # Read Scripture, Search Bible, Bookmarks & Offline Reading tabs
│   │   ├── PassageNavigation.jsx # Testament filters (All/OT/NT), Book/Chapter/Verse dropdowns
│   │   ├── ScriptureReader.jsx # Scripture chapter reader with circular verse numbers & controls
│   │   ├── SearchPanel.jsx     # Keyword Scripture search interface
│   │   ├── BookmarksPanel.jsx  # Saved local bookmarks panel
│   │   └── OfflinePanel.jsx    # Offline storage management panel
│   └── README.md               # Detailed module documentation
└── README.md                   # This file
```

---

## How It Works

### 1. Standalone or Unified Serving
- When running the FastAPI backend (`python backend/run_server.py`), FastAPI automatically serves this frontend at `http://localhost:8000/`.
- The Church landing page is accessible at `http://localhost:8000/`.
- The Online Bible React application is accessible at `http://localhost:8000/bible/`.

### 2. Multi-Frontend & Future Frontend Compatibility
In the future, if you develop a separate frontend (such as a Next.js, Vite, or mobile app) running on a different port or server (e.g. `http://localhost:5173`):
- The backend has **CORS fully enabled** for all origins (`*`).
- You can configure the API endpoint URL by setting `window.API_BASE_URL`:
  ```html
  <script>
    window.API_BASE_URL = "http://localhost:8000";
  </script>
  ```
- If `window.API_BASE_URL` is omitted or empty, it automatically defaults to relative paths (`/api/bible/...`), ensuring zero-configuration operation when served by FastAPI or a reverse proxy.

---

## Key Features

- **React Functional Architecture**: Pure JavaScript (JSX) components utilizing React Hooks (`useState`, `useEffect`, `useMemo`, `useCallback`).
- **Bilingual Scripture**: English King James Version (KJV) and Telugu Holy Bible (పరిశుద్ధ గ్రంథము).
- **Interactive Controls**: Dynamic font scaling (`A-` / `A+`), light & dark theme switching, bookmarking, and 1-click verse copying.
- **Passage Selector**: Filter by testament (`All`, `OT`, `NT`), select books, chapters, and verses with responsive navigation.
- **Verse of the Day**: Curated daily devotional banner with chapter jump and bilingual citations.

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

      cursor: pointer;

      width: 52px;
      height: 52px;
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.95);

      justify-content: center;

      font-size: 1.2rem;

      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;

      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1;
      display: block;
      margin-top: 2px;

    .event-details h4 {
      margin: 0 0 0.35rem 0;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--text-primary);

    .event-meta {
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.25rem;
    }

      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* Photo Gallery Grid */
    .gallery-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.25rem;

      flex-direction: column;

      border-color: var(--border-highlight);
    }

      height: 200px;

      display: block;

      padding: 1rem 1.15rem;

      margin-bottom: 0.25rem;

    .gallery-card-desc {

      color: var(--text-muted);

    .contact-container {

      gap: 2rem;

    .contact-card, .prayer-card {

      color: var(--text-secondary);

    .prayer-form {

      background: var(--bg-card);

      color: #000;

      border: none;
      padding: 0.85rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);

      font-size: 0.95rem;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 48px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;

    .btn-submit-prayer:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background: var(--accent-gold-light);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .btn-submit-prayer:disabled {
      opacity: 0.65;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .prayer-feedback-banner {
      display: none;
      padding: 1.25rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-top: 1rem;
      animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease-out;

      display: block;
      background: var(--accent-emerald-subtle);
      border: 1px solid rgba(21, 128, 61, 0.3);
      color: var(--accent-emerald);
    }

      display: block;
      background: var(--accent-red-subtle);
      border: 1px solid rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.3);
      color: var(--accent-red);
    }

    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .donate-card {

      line-height: 1.7;

    .donate-options-grid {

      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.25rem;
      margin-top: 1.75rem;
      text-align: left;

    .donate-box {
      background: var(--bg-input);
      padding: 1.35rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.4rem;
    }

    .donate-box h4 {
      color: var(--accent-gold);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    }

    .donate-box p {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.55;
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* Footer */
    .church-footer {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
      padding: 2.5rem 1.25rem;
      margin-top: 3rem;
    }

    .footer-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    .footer-links {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin: 0.5rem 0;
    }

    .footer-links a {
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: color 0.2s ease;
    }

    .footer-links a:hover {
      color: var(--accent-gold);
    }

    /* Responsive Breakpoints */
    @media (max-width: 1040px) {
      .nav-desktop {
        display: none;
      }
      .hamburger-btn {
        display: flex;
      }
      .mobile-drawer {
        display: block;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .btn-portal-launch, .btn-hero-primary, .btn-hero-secondary {
        width: 100%;
        justify-content: center;
      }
      .portal-features-list {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .about-grid, .sermons-grid, .events-grid, .ministries-grid, .gallery-grid, .contact-container {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .event-card {
        flex-direction: column;
      }
      .page-container {
        padding: 1rem 0.85rem 3rem 0.85rem;
        gap: 2.5rem;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .nav-subtitle {
        display: none;
      }
      .nav-container {
        padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
      }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- ========================================================================
       JavaScript Controller: Navigation, Theme Toggle, Sermons & Prayer API
       ======================================================================== -->
  <script>
    // 1. Theme Switcher (Light / Dark mode persisted in localStorage)
    const themeBtn = document.getElementById('btn-theme-switcher');
    const htmlElement = document.documentElement;

    function applyTheme(theme) {
      htmlElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
      if (themeBtn) {
        themeBtn.textContent = theme === 'dark' ? '🌙' : '☀️';
      }
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('church_theme', theme);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('church_theme') || 'light';
    applyTheme(savedTheme);

    if (themeBtn) {
      themeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const currentTheme = htmlElement.getAttribute('data-theme') || 'light';
        const newTheme = currentTheme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
        applyTheme(newTheme);
      });
    }

    // 2. Mobile Drawer Navigation Controller
    const hamburgerBtn = document.getElementById('hamburger-btn');
    const mobileDrawer = document.getElementById('mobile-drawer');

    function toggleMenu() {
      const isOpen = hamburgerBtn.classList.toggle('is-active');
      mobileDrawer.classList.toggle('is-open', isOpen);
      hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
      mobileDrawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', isOpen ? 'false' : 'true');
    }

    if (hamburgerBtn) {
      hamburgerBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleMenu);
    }

    // Auto-close menu on link click
    document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link, .btn-mobile-donate').forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (hamburgerBtn && mobileDrawer) {
          hamburgerBtn.classList.remove('is-active');
          mobileDrawer.classList.remove('is-open');
          hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          mobileDrawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        }
      });
    });

    // Close when tapping outside
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (mobileDrawer && !e.target.closest('#floating-navbar') && mobileDrawer.classList.contains('is-open')) {
        hamburgerBtn.classList.remove('is-active');
        mobileDrawer.classList.remove('is-open');
        hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        mobileDrawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      }
    });

    // 3. Scrollspy & Dynamic Floating Navbar Shadow
    const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item[href^="#"], .mobile-nav-link[href^="#"]');
    const trackedSections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');
    const navbar = document.getElementById('floating-navbar');

    function onScrollUpdate() {
      if (navbar) {
        if (window.scrollY > 20) {
          navbar.classList.add('scrolled');
        } else {
          navbar.classList.remove('scrolled');
        }
      }

      const scrollPos = window.scrollY + 120;
      let currentSection = 'home';

      trackedSections.forEach(section => {
        const top = section.offsetTop;
        const height = section.offsetHeight;
        if (scrollPos >= top && scrollPos < top + height) {
          currentSection = section.getAttribute('id');
        }
      });

      navItems.forEach(item => {
        const targetId = item.getAttribute('href');
        if (targetId === `#${currentSection}`) {
          item.classList.add('active');
        } else if (targetId && targetId.startsWith('#')) {
          item.classList.remove('active');
        }
      });
    }

    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScrollUpdate, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('load', onScrollUpdate);

    // 4. Sermon Playback Helper
    function playSermonAudio(playerId) {
      const audio = document.getElementById(playerId);
      if (audio) {
        if (audio.paused) {
          // Pause all other audio players
          document.querySelectorAll('audio').forEach(a => {
            if (a !== audio) a.pause();
          });
          audio.play().catch(err => {
            console.log('Audio playback info:', err);
          });
        } else {
          audio.pause();
        }
      }
    }

    // 5. Prayer Request Form Submission connected to Backend API
    const prayerForm = document.getElementById('prayer-form');
    const feedbackBanner = document.getElementById('prayer-feedback');
    const submitBtn = document.getElementById('btn-submit-prayer');
    const submitText = document.getElementById('prayer-submit-text');

    if (prayerForm) {
      prayerForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();

        const nameInput = document.getElementById('prayer-name');
        const contactInput = document.getElementById('prayer-contact');
        const requestInput = document.getElementById('prayer-request');

        const name = nameInput ? nameInput.value.trim() : '';
        const contact = contactInput ? contactInput.value.trim() : '';
        const request = requestInput ? requestInput.value.trim() : '';

        // Frontend validation
        if (!contact || contact.length < 3) {
          showFeedback('Please provide a valid email or phone number for pastoral follow-up.', 'error');
          if (contactInput) contactInput.focus();
          return;
        }

        if (!request || request.length < 5) {
          showFeedback('Please write a brief description of your prayer request.', 'error');
          if (requestInput) requestInput.focus();
          return;
        }

        // Show loading state
        submitBtn.disabled = true;
        submitText.textContent = 'Submitting Request... ⏳';
        hideFeedback();

        try {
          const apiBase = window.API_BASE_URL || '';
          const response = await fetch(`${apiBase}/api/prayer-request`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Accept': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              name: name || undefined,
              contact: contact,
              request: request
            })
          });

          if (!response.ok) {
            let errorMsg = 'Unable to send your request. Please try again or call the church office.';
            try {
              const errData = await response.json();
              if (errData && errData.detail) {
                errorMsg = Array.isArray(errData.detail)
                  ? errData.detail.map(d => d.msg).join(', ')
                  : errData.detail;
              }
            } catch (_) {}
            throw new Error(errorMsg);
          }

          const result = await response.json();

          // ONLY SHOW SUCCESS UPON ACTUAL 200 SUCCESSFUL RESPONSE
          const displayName = name ? name : 'Beloved';
          showFeedback(`✓ Thank you, ${displayName}! Your prayer request (Ref: ${result.request_id || 'Received'}) has been sent to our pastoral prayer team. We will intercede for you in prayer.`, 'success');

          // Reset form fields
          prayerForm.reset();
        } catch (err) {
          // NEVER show success on failure
          showFeedback(`⚠️ ${err.message || 'Network error: could not submit prayer request. Please check your connection.'}`, 'error');
        } finally {
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
          submitText.textContent = 'Send Prayer Request 🙏';
        }
      });
    }

    function showFeedback(message, type) {
      if (feedbackBanner) {
        feedbackBanner.textContent = message;
        feedbackBanner.className = `prayer-feedback-banner ${type}`;
      }
    }

    function hideFeedback() {
      if (feedbackBanner) {
        feedbackBanner.className = 'prayer-feedback-banner';
        feedbackBanner.textContent = '';
      }
    }
  </script>
